data.name: Death's Kiss
data.description: You can cause a creature to take on some of the traits of the undead with a melee touch attack. Touched creatures are treated as undead for the purposes of effects that heal or cause damage based on positive and negative energy. This effect lasts for %1 rounds. It does not apply to the Turn Undead or Command Undead feats. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|max(1,DomainLVL/2)|DomainDeathTimes
